name: 云梦乡镇独立边界和地名图层
permittedProjectScope: User confirmed noncommercial demo. Provider prohibits commercial use.
coordinateConvention: Source EWKB declares EPSG:4326; retained as supplied, without GCJ inverse, affine fitting, or displacement.

coordinateHypothesisCheck.meaning: Cross-source consistency only; not survey-grade coordinate certification.

processing: Retain all 13 source polygon coordinates unchanged in the source file.
Derive interior linework; remove only exterior county rings with 1 m tolerance, not internal sliver edges, to preserve continuous shared town boundaries.
Separate development-zone lines and render dashed.
Clip display linework to the existing project county without changing the county or filling gaps.
Use interior polylabel anchors; they do not indicate government seats.
limitations: No newer officially surveyed township geometry was obtained.
The county outline and township dataset have different generalization and vintage, so local seams can differ.
The planning map center-city extent is not treated as Chengguan town; no inferred merge with the development zone.
Topology/coordinate consistency checks do not constitute official approval.
